# The Viper Group
Formerly a privateering company operating under the wing of a now-destroyed Syndicate operation, domineered by military discipline with the sole mission of disrupting interstellar shipping routes along the fringes of occupied space. After the Great Expansion ripped the galaxy apart, the Viper Group saw an opportunity to exploit the galactic situation after the devastation and formed a branch office in the outer Perseus arm to facilitate local operations to continue their business model of "pirates for hire", though spoken less plainly.
Post-Expansion the Vipers had entirely migrated into the Perseus arm with a PMC front, moving away from being associated publicly with the PDV's military and acting independently. With the USSP growing content with their sphere of influence amongst the stars following a series of devastating TSF incursions reclaiming territory from the USSP, the Vipers left their domain to prowl with their best virtue; Greed. The Vipers expanded their reach to target more opportunistic areas where one would not look twice their way upon catching their insignia, such as destabilized frontier planets and spacehubs of various groups of interest as they became notorious for conducting raids on supply and shipping routes; most notably those of the emergent TSF and PD. With leadership often violently switching hands once a Viper commander's fangs grow dull, the Vipers are seen as a wildcard whose only interest is credits and fullfilling contracts to the letter.
